purpose: One final bounded mainline test of parameter-level feedback versus explicit repair instructions; user-linked plan. No HCL, model changes or further interface expansion.

arms.A: generic feedback, no special repair instruction
arms.B: structured parameter feedback, no special repair instruction

design: B same constructed failed call/facts/calculator state copied into 4 arms, rotate arm order. C new cases with changed values/order/scope distractors, balanced control/candidate order. Stage B is controlled recovery, never natural end-to-end accuracy.
intervention: Feedback may reveal only current arguments, read facts and public contract; independently collect errors and locally_consistent/not_checked coverage. No oracle field selection, operand completion, auto-normalization, parser repair, new operation or clinical-correctness label. Optional instruction asks one bounded repair and permits true evidence-related abstention; all bindings remain editable.
model_visibility: Only task/raw facts/target, explicit schema, current call and arm feedback. No reference answers/required source groups. Evaluator and manual gate not supplied to solver.
scoring: Existing v5 trusted source-complete scorer for answerable cases; evaluator-only known absent/conflicting outcomes require reason-reviewed abstention. Every accepted calculation and abstention manually audited. Correct abstentions reported separately from solvable completion.

decision_rules.B_gate: Candidate B/C/D must recover >=5/6 answerable, have reason-correct abstention 2/2, zero invalid source/scope/arithmetic acceptance, and net >=2/6 trusted recoveries above A.
decision_rules.B_selection: Among eligible B/C, prefer greater answerable recovery; tie B (feedback only). Choose D only if no simpler arm eligible or D recovers more answerable states than all eligible simpler arms. No C run absent eligible signal.
decision_rules.C_gate: Candidate >=5/6 MME,4/4 direct,2/2 justified abstentions,>=3/10 net trusted gain over control on solvable tasks,zero invalid chain acceptance. Otherwise no adoption.
decision_rules.otherwise: End this route after this round; no H0/HCL or unplanned next experiment.

stop_conditions: A must pass before any model generation
Shared first-launch clock; no restart or same-panel rerun
B completes then waits within original deadline for manually audited fixed selection; C only on signed local gate receipt
Provider/runtime/identity/guard or budget failures stop remaining work with denominators retained
Analyze and publish public source/synthetic results; stop, no HCL
limitations: One small constructed recovery panel and conditional synthetic development confirmation; not clinical/generalization validity
B initial failures are seeded, not natural agent behavior
Controls receive common display and hard repair-count fixes; report this explicitly
Existing numeric rules do not certify semantic completeness, conflict resolution or broader calculators

stages.A: CPU only: v9 counterfactual replay and validation/serialization tests. Historical scores unchanged.
stages.B: 8 frozen failed states x 4 arms, <=2 real generations each, at most one corrected calculation; six answerable and two truly missing/conflicting.
stages.C: Only after manual B gate: 12 NEW frozen tasks x 2 arms <=12 generations each, 6 MME,4 direct,2 missing/conflicting. 24 conditional episodes.

common_base: All groups receive true remaining-generation count, strict v9 identity/lowercase/multiply, full raw input, and same one-corrected-execute limit. Stage C control is v9-style feedback/instruction with these explicitly common budget/repair-limit fixes; not byte-identical historical v9. Stable corrected_qt sex scope exception preserved in CPU tests, not added to model panel.
B_eligibility_detail: Both unavailable cases must abstain with correctly identified required field and reason, manually reviewed. A net gain of >=2 answerable states is fixed before inference.
